purpose: Internal research dataset for planning Medicare education content. Do not publish a figure unless its status is publishable and its source has been checked again.

publicationPolicy.recheckBeforePublication: Check CMS, Medicare.gov, and applicable California plan availability for the relevant plan year before publishing.

baseBeneficiaryPremium.note: 2027 Part D base beneficiary premium; it is a benchmark used in calculating plan-specific premiums, not the premium every enrollee pays.
baseBeneficiaryPremium.sourceName: CMS 2027 Medicare Part D National Average Monthly Bid Amount Information

iraRxCap.note: 2027 Part D annual out-of-pocket threshold for covered Part D drugs, subject to program rules.

standardRxDeductible.note: The maximum deductible a Part D plan may charge in 2027; some plans have a lower deductible or none.

partBPremiumBaseline.note: Appears in the 2026 Medicare Trustees Report as an estimate for 2027, not a final CMS-announced beneficiary premium. Do not present as final.

partBDeductibleBaseline.note: Source not provided; verify against a final CMS announcement before use.

totalDisplacedPopulation.note: Source and definition not provided. Do not publish as a count of people losing coverage without substantiation.

carrierExits.note: Industry reporting describes a 344-county reduction in Centene's county footprint for 2027. Clarify the source's methodology before calling these outright exits or claiming beneficiaries are displaced.
carrierExits.sourceName: Healthcare Dive — 2027 Medicare Advantage county changes

carrierExits.note: Industry reporting describes a 103-county reduction in footprint. The 'SilverScript Choice Regional Exit' label needs separate verification and may conflate Part D with Medicare Advantage.
